Subject: High latencies + 502s during peak - urgent

Impacting checkout flows for several marketplaces. Our ops team captured traces (attached) and would like an immediate post-incident read and timeline.

Can you confirm the root cause and an ETA for recovery? This is hitting our business KPIs — we need an exec-level update in the next 3 hours.

Thanks,
Samir

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 10:05:31 -0700
Subject: RE: High latencies + 502s during peak - urgent

On the bridge we correlating tokenization spikes with an upstream change in batch window heuristics that pushed request consolidation into a hot-path causing KV cache thrashing. Preliminary notes:
- Symptom: 95th latency jumped from ~120ms to ~820ms for requests >512 tokens and error rate to ~3.8% (502/timeout)
- Root cause (prelim): regression in the batching heuristic introduced 02/28 that increased contiguous KV cache churn on the dedicated pool used by HelixMart (model variant xlarge-quant4f)
- Short-term mitigation: momentarily route traffic to xlarge-quant4f-v2 (same weights, older batching heuristics) + bump per-model concurrency to absorb batch reshuffling
- Evidence attached: helixmart_tokenized_spans_logs_0301.zip (token distribution + KV miss traces)

We can enact the routing change as an automatic fallback within 10 minutes; longer-term fix requires a small runtime patch and a canary rollout.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime

Thanks for surfacing this. We've applied the temporary routing to xlarge-quant4f-v2 and are seeing tail latencies drop toward baseline in the last 6 minutes. From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 16:00:12 -0700
Subject: HelixMart - Incident summary, RCA, and recovery commitments

Samir / Leila —

Attached is our formal root cause report (HelixMart_RootCauseReport_20280302.pdf) and the tokenized traces zip we referenced during triage. Executive summary (TL;DR):
- What happened: a recently deployed batching heuristic change caused increased KV cache churn for long-sequence traffic on HelixMart's dedicated pool, elevating tail latency and producing intermittent 502s.
- Impact window: 2028-03-01 08:45–09:05 PDT. Peak error rate ~3.8%; peak p95 latency ~820ms.
- Immediate mitigation: traffic routed to stable variant within ~10 minutes of detection; customer-facing impact reduced within the hour.
- Root fix: rollback of heuristic + runtime patch to make batching adaptive to token-distribution — targeted canary 2028-03-05, full rollout 2028-03-09 (owners below).

Commitments and owners (short list):
- Runtime patch & canary (owner: karthik_iyer) — canary: 2028-03-05, full rollout: 2028-03-09
- Longer-term KV cache telemetry improvements (owner: marissa_cole) — design review: 2028-03-12
- SLA credit review & billing reconciliation (owner: kimberly_park) — proposal by 2028-03-07
- Weekly status reports for HelixMart (owner: grace_oconnor) — starting 2028-03-06, 4-week cadence

Links and artifacts:
- RCA PDF (attached)
- Tokenized traces (attached)
- Live incident console: https://redwood.console/company/helixmart/incidents/20280301

Please let us know if HelixMart would like a tailored post-mortem engineering session; we can schedule a 60–90 minute deep dive with Karthis and the runtime team.

Ben Carter
Account Lead, Priority Customers
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HelixMart_RootCauseReport_20280302.pdf (report), helixmart_tokenized_spans_logs_0301.zip (token traces)
